title: verify external HTTPS object descriptor against current bytes without granting install authority

criteria: Verifier rejects non-HTTPS, mutable, local, credential-bearing, stale, size-mismatched, digest-mismatched, or authority-bearing object references.
Verifier records whether the descriptor matches current bytes and drift-zero evidence.
Verifier never treats endpoint reachability as trust and never grants install, activation, rollback, support upload, or remote dispatch authority.
